snippet.title: ROTETRA - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo (and wishlist): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4306820/ROTETRA
Play on web: https://sharkwithlasers.itch.io/rotetra

ROTETRA is a twisted tetromino stacker where you spin the whole board and juggle multiple pieces at once!
